crossRefs.note: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

people.name: Peleg
people.line: Descendant of Shem, ancestor of Abraham

people.name: Reu
people.line: Son of Peleg, ancestor of Abraham

translations.web: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Reu, Peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
translations.asv: and Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
